If you’re excited to shape the next generation of intelligent systems, we’d love to hear from you. At Perceptual, you’ll work on open problems in SLAM, sensor fusion, and GPU acceleration — and see your solutions validated on real equipment in demanding environments worldwide. You’ll collaborate with a team that combines MIT research depth with large-scale engineering experience from Stripe, Twitter, and Google X. Get in touch at <a href="mailto:jobs@perceptual.ai">jobs@perceptual.ai</a>.

[Perception Engineer]{.team-name} [| Remote]{.team-title}\

As a Perception Engineer, you will design and implement SLAM systems that power real-world robotics applications across industries such as construction, logistics, and defense. You'll work on core challenges in localization, mapping, and sensor fusion—integrating LiDAR, cameras, radar, and inertial data into robust, real-time systems. The role involves developing GPU-accelerated algorithms, optimizing for on-device performance, and collaborating closely with customers to adapt solutions to their environments.
